note: Every value below was read from the vendor's own documentation on verifiedOn, not from memory or from third-party blog roundups. Fields marked volatile:true are NOT fixed constants — resolve them at runtime from the cited source. Re-verify the whole file if verifiedOn is more than ~90 days old; platform limits change without notice and a stale spec fails a render silently.

omitted.safeAreaInsets: Deliberately omitted. UI-overlay safe areas (caption bars, action rails) are widely repeated in blog posts but we found no primary vendor source that states them. Rather than encode a guess that agents would trust, we leave them out. If you need them, measure against the live app and add them with a source.

sourceQuotes.maxDurationSec: short-form videos that are up to 3 minutes long
sourceQuotes.maxResolution: You can upload Short videos with a maximum resolution of 1080p.

platforms.name: Instagram Reels
platforms.containerNote: MPEG-4 Part 14, no edit lists, moov atom at the front of the file.
platforms.videoCodecNote: progressive scan, closed GOP, 4:2:0 chroma subsampling

sourceQuotes.aspectRatioBounds: between 0.01:1 and 10:1 but we recommend 9:16 to avoid cropping or blank space

maxDurationResolver.why: TikTok does not publish a single fixed upload duration. The cap is per-creator and is returned by the creator_info API, which clients are required to check before posting. Hardcoding a number here would be wrong for most accounts.

chunkedUpload.note: Files under 5 MB must be uploaded whole; files over 64 MB must be chunked.
